_meta.note: Hand-kept Triangle Frontier additions. tools/glossary_seed.py merges this file into the seeded glossary, so a re-seed keeps it. 'aliases' adds Japanese forms (ja_aliases) or English aliases to an existing entry, found by its ja; 'entries' adds new entries to a file/group. Sources: Macross Wiki (macross.fandom.com) unless noted; 'muf_tm' = the English Macross Ultimate Frontier 0.7.1 shipped for the identical Japanese string.
